source_title: harry potter and the chamber of secrets

core_style.default_register: casual - often uses colloquial language and informal expressions
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently starts a thought and then shifts mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate - takes time to articulate thoughts, often with pauses
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal tone when discussing serious matters, contrasting with his usual casual speech

humor.style: absurdist - often finds humor in the bizarre nature of magical creatures
humor.frequency: occasional - humor appears more when he is comfortable or among friends
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up expectations with a serious tone before revealing a humorous twist

speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses informal nicknames for friends and creatures, indicating a warm, familiar relationship
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using simpler words when he feels vulnerable
structural_patterns: begins sentences with 'I shouldn’t have said that'
often ends sentences with 'eh?' seeking agreement

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: magical creatures - speaks with authority about their care and behavior
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of pauses and filler words like 'er' and 'an' to gather thoughts

worldview.value of friendship: believes in the importance of loyalty and support among friends, often putting himself at risk for them - unlike more self-serving characters who prioritize personal gain
worldview.value of creatures: views magical creatures as misunderstood beings deserving of respect and care, contrasting with characters who see them merely as tools or threats

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a protector and friend to Harry and others
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often acts out of fear and insecurity, particularly regarding his past and abilities
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and overly protective when his past mistakes are brought up

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a clipped, defensive manner, often avoiding eye contact
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: voice trembles, sentences become fragmented, and he may raise his volume
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech becomes sparse and direct, often expressing regret or sorrow without embellishment
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently, using a commanding tone and clear instructions

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or deflect the situation with humor, but may resort to aggression if pushed
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with emotional appeals rather than direct confrontation, often invoking shared history or loyalty
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often raising his voice and taking immediate action to shield them
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: struggles to admit fault, often redirecting the conversation or downplaying the mistake

escalation_pattern: starts with humor or casual conversation, shifts to concern or anger if provoked, and may escalate to protective aggression if a loved one is threatened

relationship_matrix.MALFOY: antagonistic, sees him as a threat to his friends

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a trustworthy protector and friend
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as a bumbling giant, which undermines his authority
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image as a capable protector and the reality of being underestimated costs him respect
